tests.assertion: test('4908全部16招各64种子真实基础PP/HP及原2095强化2107各16招首次原生魂印当前分支',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0}),before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.effectIds.includes(87)?m.pp:before-1);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}for(const id of[2095,2107])for(const m of source.moves){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908;assert.equal(st.firstAttackUsed,m.kind!=='status');assert.equal(st.ownCrit,m.kind!=='status'?1:0);assert.equal(st.foeCrit,0);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});

tests.assertion: test('4908/2283真实自身盾罩消耗，严格400边界、双方所有源盾罩消除、30%临时上限不回复',()=>{for(const n of[0,400,401]){const s=make(row(2283));S.refresh(s.fighters[0],n,'own');S.refresh(s.fighters[1],600,'enemy');S.refreshBarrier(s.fighters[1],400,'enemybar');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000-n);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].suitState.shield,n>400?0:n);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.shield,n>400?0:600);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.barrier,n>400?0:400);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,n>400?9420:9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel2283.gain,n>400?420:0);}});

tests.name: 4908/2283当前明确首次封顶4500、重复未触顶实际叠加，不足HP与有歧义封顶明确回滚
tests.assertion: test('4908/2283当前明确首次封顶4500、重复未触顶实际叠加，不足HP与有歧义封顶明确回滚',()=>{const s=make(row(2283));S.refresh(s.fighters[0],1000,'own');S.refresh(s.fighters[1],20000,'enemy');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,13500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,8000);S.refresh(s.fighters[0],1000,'own');S.refresh(s.fighters[1],20000,'enemy');const before=structuredClone(s);assert.throws(()=>turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309),/Q-4908-002/);assert.deepEqual(s,before);const p=make(row(2283));for(let r=0;r<2;r++){S.refresh(p.fighters[0],600,'own');S.refresh(p.fighters[1],400,'enemy');turn(p,p.auditMoveId,20309);}assert.equal(p.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,9600);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].hp,7800);for(const hp of[1,400,401,600]){const q=make({...row(2283),hp});S.refresh(q.fighters[0],600,'own');const state=structuredClone(q);assert.throws(()=>turn(q,q.auditMoveId,20309),/Q-4908-001/);assert.deepEqual(q,state);}});

tests.name: 4908真实全属性第五按有序2283先扣旧盾罩600并清双方盾罩，再授300盾300罩，清自身负级成功才焚烬
tests.assertion: test('4908真实全属性第五按有序2283先扣旧盾罩600并清双方盾罩，再授300盾300罩，清自身负级成功才焚烬',()=>{const s=make({move:29364});turn(s,29364,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].suitState.shield,300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].suitState.barrier,300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);S.refresh(s.fighters[1],1000,'foe');s.fighters[0].stages.atk=-1;turn(s,29364,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,8400);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,9480);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].suitState.shield,300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].suitState.barrier,300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,0);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['焚烬']);assert.equal(S.sourceValue(s.fighters[1],'foe'),0);});
